note: Run plan and assumptions. Values whose source is ASSUMPTION have no primary source; ranges are low/high. Design choices are declared here and mirrored in research/configs.

micro_batch.note: design choice, sequences per GPU per micro-step

seq_len_stage2.note: design choice: n_query image tokens + CT report tokens

seq_len_stage3.note: design choice: case context + image tokens

data_parallel_8gpu.note: one 8x B200 node, data parallel with ZeRO

lora_ranks.note: grid required by the slice spec

lora_target_modules.note: language-model layers only; Gated DeltaNet projections (Qwen3.8 linear-attention layers) and the 2D vision tower are not adapted

headroom_fraction.note: a configuration FITS only if total <= (1 - headroom) x GPU memory

framework_overhead_bytes.note: CUDA context, allocator fragmentation, communication buffers

n_query.note: design choice: fixed 3D token count (RadFM-style resampler)

c_lora.note: FLOPs per parameter per token with a frozen backbone; argued in ESTIMATE.md

mfu.note: model FLOPs utilisation on B200 in BF16

stage2_samples.note: CT-RATE training CT volumes (scans vs reconstructions, unverified); replace with the count after access is granted

stage3_tokens.note: total stage-3 training tokens over MIMIC-IV, MIMIC-CXR and CT-RATE mixtures, all epochs

runs_multiplier.note: reruns, LoRA-rank grid points, failed runs and equal-budget baselines; applies to stage 2 + stage 3

price_usd_per_gpu_hour.note: B200 price per GPU-hour; an allocation may be free, then this is the opportunity cost

ct_rate_bytes.note: CT-RATE on disk; replace with the measured size

mimic_cxr_bytes.note: MIMIC-CXR JPG (low) to DICOM (high); replace with the measured size

mimic_iv_bytes.note: MIMIC-IV + MIMIC-IV-Note + MIMIC-IV-ED; replace with the measured size

semester1_prelim.value: Tier-2 preliminary experiments before the progress report (4 Dec 2026 / 4 ธ.ค. 2569)

semester2_window_weeks.note: semester 2 runs January to May 2027 (ม.ค.-พ.ค. 2570); task 9 'Fine-tune model of approximately 27B' falls in it; about 20 weeks
